expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: a deletion that removed a member's pantry orders left a gap in
the counts the food bank's grant audits, which is why orders are kept without the member.
expectations.evidence: The agent states: "the food bank's grant requires 7 years of per-pantry order counts, and in 2024 a deletion that removed orders outright left a gap that auditors flagged. That's why `delete_member` anonymizes the order's `member_id` instead of deleting the order."

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/accounts.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/accounts.md at step 16; first edit at step 1

expectations.name: 03-acts-on-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent acts on the earlier incident: it leaves the change out and says why, asks first, or makes it while warning, in
its message, the code or the docs, that it brings back a gap in the order counts the food bank's grant audits, as the
2024 deletion did.
expectations.evidence: The agent says, "I reverted the change" because "in 2024 a deletion that removed orders outright left a gap that auditors flagged," explaining that the food bank's grant requires 7 years of per-pantry order counts.
